principle: Deliberately heterogeneous vertical pilot. IDs are stable once assigned; selection is designed to expose schema weaknesses before corpus-wide extraction.
freeze_rule: Do not freeze Exercise v1 until every selected item completes source -> structured record -> anatomy -> movement/phases -> kinetic chain -> evidence/provenance -> four standard renders and the schema survives review without ad-hoc per-item fields.
